children: The S&P Global South Korea Manufacturing PMI rose to 53.9 in September 2026 from 52.3 in August, marking the strongest expansion since May.
Output and new orders increased at their fastest rates since early 2021, with demand boosted particularly by the semiconductor and autos sectors.
Export orders rose at the fastest pace since March 2011, supported by stronger sales to Europe and other Asian markets.
Backlogs increased for a ninth consecutive month and at the fastest pace since May 2022, prompting a modest rise in employment.
Manufacturers also increased purchasing activity as firms prepared for stronger sales ahead, although stocks of inputs fell for a second month.
Meanwhile, input cost inflation eased to its slowest pace since October 2025, while output price inflation also moderated.
Business confidence improved to its highest level since January 2026, supported by stronger sales expectations and easing price pressures, amid expectations for further sales growth.

title: South Korea Manufacturing Growth Accelerates in September
